new192_sensitivity.cluster_rule: Resample40 tasks with all retained4/5 init pairs; replicate difference=sum(deltas)/sum(episodes). Per-suite10 tasks/48 episodes.

method.cluster: Globally resample40 (suite,task) units; keep all five paired inits. Per-suite resamples10 tasks.
method.episode_sensitivity: Resample200 paired episodes (50 per-suite); do not resample arms independently.
method.exact_test: Two-sided conditional binomial McNemar; double smaller tail, capped1; no mid-p.
method.multiplicity: Holm correction for three overall candidate-vs-fresh tests. Direct and per-suite analyses exploratory.
method.pairing: suite/task/init; seed/model/checkpoint/protocol compatibility must be audited separately.

limitations: p>0.05 does not establish no effect or noninferiority.
No user-approved noninferiority margin;1/2/5pp flags are descriptive, not pass/fail SLOs.
Exact McNemar is conditional under independent episode discordances; within-task dependence limits population interpretation. Task-cluster bootstrap is the main uncertainty sensitivity.
Only40 task clusters; sparse discordances and ceiling success can give degenerate/unreliable bootstrap intervals.
Fixed selected tasks/inits and one model seed do not establish overall LIBERO or robot-population quality.
Valid task failures remain outcomes. Technical failures are separate and prevent completion. Repeated attempts cannot replace a valid failed episode.

pilot_reuse_evidence.scope: Receipt provenance reference; full compatibility audit is separate from statistical calculations.
